submitted.rationale: Index 8 (Mn0.79) had the highest photocurrent measured (+1e-8 A). All three measurements are at the noise level, which suggests the Mn-Y oxide line is basically inactive at 3.22 eV. XRD showed the same single peak (Q≈2.785 Å⁻¹) across the whole composition range, so it gave no phase contrast to guide the choice. The Mn-rich end gave the only positive signal.

rejected.reason: Measured 0 A at the Y-rich end

rejected.hypothesis: A distinct phase region (e.g. hexagonal YMnO3 near Mn0.5) gives higher activity
rejected.reason: XRD at Mn 0.15, 0.36, 0.51, 0.65 and 0.79 showed the same single peak, with no phase boundary
